name: Ton
notes: Default: the TON symbol from the official Media Assets kit (ton.org/media). Geometry is the vector symbol of `TON Logo White.svg` (ton_white_logo.zip); colours follow `TON Logo on White` (ton_logo.zip), a #0098EA disc with a white mark, whose symbol is shipped only as an embedded PNG. Drawn full-bleed as a container
Mono: the vector symbol of `TON Logo White.svg` unchanged, the disc in currentColor with the mark knocked out
